title: UI conventions
summary: House rules for Grimoire renderer UI: design tokens over raw values, shared primitives over ad-hoc markup, radius/focus scale, i18n and no em-dashes.
notes: Type set by MANIFEST_TYPE=ADR (manifest authoritative). Document has no status field and no Context/Decision/Consequences structure, so locked stays false. Precedence 0 from MANIFEST_PRECEDENCE.
